nom: Lancôme Clarifique Bx-Interceptor Acne Treatment with Glycolic & Salicylic Acid

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the largest group and mostly report no stinging, dryness, or irritation, including several who call it gentle enough for reactive or easily irritated skin; the dissent is fragrance-related, with several cautioning the strong scent could be overwhelming for those sensitive to it, and one warning the triple-acid-and-niacinamide formula weakened her skin barrier with daily all-over use.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who names dry skin found the treatment dried her skin out somewhat and left a sticky texture, so she limited use to spot-treating breakouts at night rather than applying it all over.
segments.oily: The one reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin found the serum lightweight and non-irritating, absorbing well without adding heaviness.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers are divided on dryness: several say the serum does not dry out skin and even feels hydrating, but a consistent minority, especially when applied all over rather than as a spot treatment, report it leaving skin dry or a bit tight, with a couple layering a moisturizer on top to counteract it.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness say the treatment visibly calms it, often reducing the size and redness of a breakout overnight, though a few note it reduces rather than fully eliminates redness and works better as a spot treatment than a complete fix.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer who specifically discusses her skin barrier warns that daily all-over use of the triple-acid-and-niacinamide formula weakened it and triggered more breakouts on her chin, which contrasts with the majority who report no barrier issues when using it as a spot treatment.
concerns.spots: Reviewers who track post-acne marks are split: some say marks fade and become less noticeable with continued use, but one says she hasn't noticed her marks fading any quicker than they would have without the product, despite otherwise liking it.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report the treatment clears individual blemishes within one to a few days and reduces overall breakout frequency, including several who call it the best spot treatment they've tried; dissent includes reviewers who saw more breakouts after all-over daily use, one who went through a purging phase before improvement, and several who say it works only on mild acne or larger spots and does little for cystic or very small blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who addresses oiliness says the treatment made her skin less oily and smoother with use.

aspects.libelle: Dropper applicator fiddly or dispenses unevenly
Sticky or tacky feel on application
Pricey relative to other salicylic acid options

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product makes a lot of acne clearing and prevention claims that it doesn't completely live up to unfortunately. I have a few different blemish clearing salicylic acid serums and i noticed after initially testing this one for 2 weeks, i was always reaching for other brands that actually worked. Unfortunately, this one does not clear blemishes nearly as quickly as other ones I've tried. As for prevention, due to the triple acid blend AND niacinamide, with daily use this can actually cause blemishes due to it weakening the skin barrier. I experienced more breakouts on my chin after the 2 weeks of using this to try and clear some texture on my forehead and breakouts on my cheek. Unfortunately, this is not a product i will be repurchasing or recommending as it didn't work for me.

First of all, I love this packaging. It looks so luxurious and fancy. I love the dropper applicator too, it's hygienic and aesthetically pleasing. Unfortunately, this treatment does not help cystic acne for me. Used twice a day, a normal cyst is a little less red, but not any smaller. They don't heal any faster with this treatment! I think this would work well for someone with mild acne or occasional small pimples, but severe/cystic acne likely will not see much result.

extraits.titre: Did Help with Breakouts,  a Bit Drying
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try this product as I am a big fan of the brand and I tend to get small breakouts every once in awhile. I have extremely dry skin so I was a bit nervous to try this product. Overall, I thought the product was okay. It did dry out my skin a bit and the texture of the serum was a bit sticky. I tried to not overuse the product and only used it during breakouts. I only applied the product at night. I do think the serum helped with the break outs, but I'm not sure if it helped enough for me to consider getting the serum once it's gone.

extraits.titre: Salicylic acid serum that's nice to sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I received this product in exchange for a review and as someone with sensitive and easily irritable skin, I was pleasantly surprised with the product! It did not sting when I put it on and laid nicely under moisturizer. I would apply once a day at night (since it contains salicylic acid I wore spf moisturizer during the day), and even after multiple days of use there was no irritation. While my acne bumps never fully went away using the product I do feel like it helped bring them down. The container is huge so it will probably last forever!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've always had clear skin through young adult through my 20s. Suddenly in my mid 30s, I'm suddenly getting hormonal sometimes cystic acne on my cheek and chin area. This product is great for on the spot treatment. I just put a drop on and rub it in daily when I see a pimple pop up and it helps expedite the time I have it and reduces redness and swelling. I'm not sure about putting it all over the face as it would be drying, but definitely would recommend for on the spot treatment.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Works incredibly well, almost too well! I have sensitive skin so acne products can often exacerbate the problem, but as long as I don't use this every day (skip at least 1 day in between treatments) it is very effective. Highly scented which I do not like, but I use it anyway because it works so well! It's a thin gel-like formula.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This is a very amazing serum for acne. Very light weight for my oily acne prone skin and doesn't irritate, absorbs really well and the instructions are super easy to read and use the product!
